CREATE TABLE pi_schema_durable_metadata (
			singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1),
			next_id TEXT NOT NULL,
			next_seq INTEGER NOT NULL
		) STRICT
INSERT INTO pi_schema_durable_metadata (singleton, next_id, next_seq) VALUES (1, '2', 1)

CREATE TABLE pi_schema_record_ids (
			id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
			record_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (record_type IN ('conversation', 'entry', 'task', 'submission', 'document'))
		) STRICT

CREATE TABLE pi_schema_conversations (
			id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
			owner_conversation_id INTEGER,
			owner_task_id INTEGER,
			record TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(record))
		) STRICT
CREATE INDEX pi_schema_conversations_by_owner_conversation ON pi_schema_conversations (owner_conversation_id, id)
CREATE INDEX pi_schema_conversations_by_owner_task ON pi_schema_conversations (owner_task_id, id)

CREATE TABLE pi_schema_entries (
			id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
			conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
			head INTEGER,
			commit_seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
			record TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(record))
		) STRICT
CREATE INDEX pi_schema_entries_by_conversation ON pi_schema_entries (conversation_id, id DESC)
CREATE INDEX pi_schema_entry_heads_by_conversation ON pi_schema_entries (conversation_id, id DESC) WHERE head IS NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE pi_schema_tasks (
			id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
			conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
			kind TEXT NOT NULL,
			status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'running', 'waiting', 'completing', 'terminal')),
			abort_requested INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (abort_requested IN (0, 1)),
			background INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (background IN (0, 1)),
			record TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(record))
		) STRICT
CREATE INDEX pi_schema_tasks_by_status ON pi_schema_tasks (status, id)
CREATE INDEX pi_schema_tasks_by_conversation ON pi_schema_tasks (conversation_id, id)
CREATE INDEX pi_schema_tasks_by_kind ON pi_schema_tasks (kind, id)
CREATE INDEX pi_schema_tasks_by_abort_requested ON pi_schema_tasks (abort_requested, id)
CREATE INDEX pi_schema_tasks_by_background ON pi_schema_tasks (background, id)

CREATE TABLE pi_schema_submissions (
			id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
			conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
			request_id TEXT,
			status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('queued', 'placed', 'done', 'unanswered')),
			record TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(record))
		) STRICT
CREATE INDEX pi_schema_submissions_by_request ON pi_schema_submissions (conversation_id, request_id)
CREATE INDEX pi_schema_submissions_by_conversation ON pi_schema_submissions (conversation_id, id)
CREATE INDEX pi_schema_submissions_by_status ON pi_schema_submissions (status, id)

CREATE TABLE pi_schema_documents (
			id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
			kind TEXT NOT NULL,
			family INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (family IN (0, 1)),
			key_value TEXT NOT NULL,
			scope_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope_kind IN ('session', 'conversation', 'task')),
			owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
			created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
			retired_at INTEGER,
			record TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(record))
		) STRICT

CREATE INDEX pi_schema_documents_by_address
			ON pi_schema_documents (kind, scope_kind, owner_id, family, key_value, created_at DESC, retired_at)
CREATE INDEX pi_schema_documents_by_scope ON pi_schema_documents (scope_kind, owner_id, id)
CREATE INDEX pi_schema_documents_by_scope_kind ON pi_schema_documents (scope_kind, owner_id, kind, id)

CREATE TABLE pi_schema_document_revisions (
			document_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
			seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
			kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('base', 'delta')),
			version INTEGER NOT NULL,
			content TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(content)),
			PRIMARY KEY (document_id, seq)
		) STRICT
CREATE INDEX pi_schema_document_revisions_by_kind ON pi_schema_document_revisions (document_id, kind, seq DESC)

CREATE TABLE pi_schema_tasks_v2 (
			id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
			conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
			kind TEXT NOT NULL,
			status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'running', 'waiting', 'sleeping', 'completing', 'terminal')),
			abort_requested INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (abort_requested IN (0, 1)),
			background INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (background IN (0, 1)),
			record TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(record))
		) STRICT

INSERT INTO pi_schema_tasks_v2 (id, conversation_id, kind, status, abort_requested, background, record)
			SELECT id, conversation_id, kind, status, abort_requested, background, record FROM pi_schema_tasks
DROP TABLE pi_schema_tasks
ALTER TABLE pi_schema_tasks_v2 RENAME TO pi_schema_tasks
CREATE INDEX pi_schema_tasks_by_status ON pi_schema_tasks (status, id)
CREATE INDEX pi_schema_tasks_by_conversation ON pi_schema_tasks (conversation_id, id)
CREATE INDEX pi_schema_tasks_by_kind ON pi_schema_tasks (kind, id)
CREATE INDEX pi_schema_tasks_by_abort_requested ON pi_schema_tasks (abort_requested, id)
CREATE INDEX pi_schema_tasks_by_background ON pi_schema_tasks (background, id)
